subject.title: TUI /sessions list: gateway-injected inbound metadata block used as session title (shows 'untrusted metadata' for all sessions)

question: Should maintainers repair/adopt https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/148 or close/ignore it and queue a fresh narrow fix against current main?
rationale: The bug is valid and narrow, but the existing cross-repo PR is open, uses closing syntax, and is conflicting, so automation should not create a competing fix until maintainers choose the branch path.

options.title: Replace with fresh fix
options.body: Close or ignore the stale conflicting fork PR and queue a new current-main repair with focused title-derivation regression coverage.

options.title: Repair the fork PR
options.body: Ask for or perform a rebase of the existing fork PR, then require real behavior proof before landing it.

recommendation.title: Replace with fresh fix
recommendation.body: Close or ignore the stale conflicting fork PR and queue a new current-main repair with focused title-derivation regression coverage.
